mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically has led to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals strengthening economic demand, which typically results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a month indicates a supply-side contraction, which historically has led to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic output declines.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending is expected to rise.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a month signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which historically has led to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the broader economy benefits from increased construction activity.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between HOUST increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% in a month, it indicates inflationary pressure during a period of relatively high interest rates, which historically has led to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with high interest rates
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive and retail and food services sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% in a month, it signals a robust consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to improve.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 positive growth and RSAFS increase > 1% in 1 month
regime_hint: economic expansion with strong consumer demand
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the interaction effect between GDPC1 growth and RSAFS increases on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
